pages.text:
Nezha has a little robot called
Little Bean.
It is round and smaller than a shoebox.
It has five buttons: forward, back, turn
left, turn right and go.
Each forward step is exactly one square.
2

Today, Little Bean has a job.
It must carry a cookie across the square
mat to Ao Bing.
Nezha puts the robot in the bottom
corner, facing up.
Next to the mat, Wukong is building a tall
block tower.
3

Nezha lines up five arrow cards: forward,
forward, turn left, forward, forward.
He presses the buttons in the same order.
“This is our program,” he says.
Then he presses go, and Little Bean starts
to roll.
4

Little Bean goes forward one square, and
then one more square.
Then it turns left and rolls straight into
Wukong’s tower.
Crash!
The blocks fall down, and the cookie falls
off the robot.
5

“Oh no, my tower!” says Wukong.
Nezha pushes all five cards into a big,
messy pile.
“This program is wrong,” he says, “so let’s
throw it away and start again!”
6

“Wait, let’s not start over yet,” says Ao
Bing. “Most of the cards might be right.
If we check one card at a time, we can
find the mistake.”
Nezha thinks for a moment and puts the
cards back in a row.
7

They put Little Bean back in the corner,
facing up.
This time, it does only one card at a time.
The first card shows forward, and it rolls
one square.
“That card is right,” says Ao Bing, and
Nezha nods.
8

The second card shows forward, too, and
Little Bean rolls one more square.
It is still on the mat, so it is still on the
way to Ao Bing.
“That one is right as well,” says Nezha.
Two cards are checked.
9

The third card shows turn left, so Little
Bean turns to the left.
Now it is facing Wukong’s blocks, not
Ao Bing.
Ao Bing puts his finger on the third card.
“This is the mistake,” he says. “It should
be turn right.”
10

Nezha fixes the program.
He swaps the turn left card for a turn
right card.
He keeps the other four cards, because
they were already right.
Now the program is forward, forward,
turn right, forward, forward.
11

Wukong puts the cookie back on
Little Bean.
Nezha presses the buttons in the new
order, then presses go.
The robot rolls two squares, turns right
and rolls two more.
It stops right in front of Ao Bing, and the
cookie arrives safely!
12

Ao Bing takes the cookie and breaks it
into three pieces, one for each friend.
Then Wukong wants to try.
He makes his own program with lots of
turn cards, because turning looks like fun.
13

Little Bean turns right, then right again,
then right again.
It spins round and round in one square and
never moves forward.
Wukong and Nezha both giggle.
“Let’s check one card at a time!”
says Nezha.
14

Then the three friends build the tower
again, block by block.
Ao Bing holds the bottom while Nezha and
Wukong add more blocks.
They build it far from Little Bean’s path,
so it will not fall again.
15

The new tower is even taller than before.
Nezha puts the five arrow cards in a neat
row beside the mat.
“Next time something goes wrong,” he
says, “I will check one card at a
time first.”
16
